audience: business owners and bookkeepers who manage company accounts and invoices in Bokio

useCases.title: Review bookkeeping setup
useCases.text: Read company information, fiscal years and the chart of accounts to understand the company's bookkeeping setup.

useCases.title: Inspect invoices and payments
useCases.text: List sales invoices, open a selected invoice and review the payments registered against it.

useCases.title: Prepare an invoice draft
useCases.text: Find an existing customer and create an invoice draft with the requested line items. Publishing or recording the invoice is a separate action.
